title: Metrics Comparison
content: Build comparison view for metrics. Period selection: select two periods to compare. Side by side: show metrics for each period. Percentage change: calculate difference between periods. Visual comparison: bar charts or overlaid lines. Highlight changes: color code improvements vs declines. Metric selection: choose which metrics to compare. Export: comparison report export.

variants.simple: Compare metrics between different time periods.

Metric selection: choose which metrics to compare. Export: comparison report export.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive metrics comparison dashboard. Comparison modes: period over period (this week vs last week), year over year (Dec 2024 vs Dec 2023), custom range vs custom range. Period selectors: two date range pickers, preset comparisons (vs Previous Period, vs Same Period Last Year). Metric display: side-by-side cards showing value for each period, percentage change calculated and displayed, absolute difference shown. Visual indicators: TrendingUp (green) for improvements, TrendingDown (red) for declines, neutral for minimal change, threshold for significance (ignore <1% changes). Comparison charts: overlaid line charts with different colors for each period, grouped bar charts for categorical data, toggle between overlay and side-by-side. Metric selection: checkbox list to choose which metrics to compare, category grouping (Revenue, Traffic, Conversions). Table format: rows as metrics, columns as periods and change, sortable by change percentage. Highlight significant changes: background highlight on metrics with large changes, configurable threshold (>10% change). Trend context: show if change is consistent with longer trend or anomaly. Breakdown comparison: compare by segment (by device, by country, by product), table showing each segment comparison. Statistical significance: for sample-based metrics, show confidence level. Notes/annotations: mark events that explain changes (holiday, campaign, bug fix). Report generation: generate comparison report, export as PDF or presentation, scheduled comparison emails. Goal comparison: compare actual vs target for each period. Insights: auto-generate text insights ("Revenue increased 15% driven by mobile users").
